answer_1.quote: Translating what is being said is arguably the most important aspect of machine translation, and has been the main focus of all its efforts so far.

answer_2.quote: We can measure this difference by computing the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence of the predicted distribution from the true sample distribution. In order to see whether the predictions differ statistically significantly from the original, we use a χ² contingency test and report significance at p <= 0.05 and p <= 0.01.
